item.title: EplayerX 1.2.30
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 修复播放异常恢复时可能出现的崩溃，改善连续报错及切换播放内容时的稳定性。 - 优化播放器兼容性回退，避免旧播放会话的延迟错误干扰当前播放。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Fixed potential crashes during playback error recovery and improved stability when errors repeat or playback content changes. - Improved compatibility fallback so delayed errors from a previous playback session do not interfere with the current session.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
